labels.mep_guide_body:
SMM2 §R–V · IFC→classify by discipline (PLB·ELEC·ACMV·FP)
Pipes/ducts → length (m) · slabs → area (m²) · fittings → count
17 country rate templates from national publications
Section totals + labour trades + charts + reinstatement value
CSV (UTF-8 BOM) or shareable self-contained HTML

labels.landing_clear_confirm:
Reset to the start screen?

Clears the in-browser building data:
  • cached buildings
  • any IFC scene you dropped in (not saved to a .db file)
and returns you to the red / blue choice.

Keeps: the installed app + offline data, and any .db you saved yourself.

labels.clash_tt_total: Total bbox overlaps detected across all discipline pairs
labels.clash_tt_resolved: Clashes fixed in the model — ready for re-check
labels.clash_tt_accepted: Risk accepted — no design change needed
labels.tm_tt_whatif: What-if: slip a phase, watch the chain re-fold in blue
labels.tm_tt_p6: P6 / MS Project interop — import a Primavera .xer/.xml or MS Project XML programme onto this model, export MSPDI/PMXML/XER, or grade an imported schedule against the model to see its own quantity + rate estimate
labels.tm_tt_lod: Draw-cost proxy: box the already-built elements outside camera view (large buildings only). OFF = today's rendering, unchanged.
labels.tm_tt_set_baseline: Snapshot current dates as the baseline for schedule variance
labels.tm_tt_pull_back: Pull every task back to the earliest start its predecessors allow (compression only — never moves a task later)
labels.tm_tt_gantt_grip: Drag to resize the Gantt drawer
labels.tm_tt_locked: Locked: drag/resize/link disabled, timeline still scrubs live. Click to unlock editing.
labels.tm_tt_editing: Editing: drag to move/resize, drag onto another bar to link, double-click for typed edit. Click to lock.
labels.tm_tt_ruler: Drag to shift the whole project's start/finish (Editing must be unlocked)
labels.tm_tt_p6_file: Import a Primavera P6 programme (.xer or .xml/PMXML) or MS Project XML (MSPDI) — adopt its WBS, logic and dates onto this model. Binding tasks to elements stays a separate, reviewable step.
labels.tm_tt_autobind: If activity names carry a BIM-Bind token (@discipline:IfcClass[:storey]), resolve it against this model and pre-bind tasks to elements on import — a reviewable first pass, not a guess.
labels.tm_tt_export_msp: Export the current schedule (WBS, dates, dependencies) as MS Project XML (MSPDI) — opens directly in Microsoft Project; re-imports here too.
labels.tm_tt_export_pmxml: Export as Primavera P6 PMXML (APIBusinessObjects XML) — the format every documented P6 export path uses; re-imports here too. Some fields (WBS code, EPS-level activity codes, resource assignments, global calendars, baselines) are not carried — P6 itself drops most of these on cross-DB import.
labels.tm_tt_export_xer: Export as Primavera XER — the older tab-delimited P6 interchange, for P6 installs that still prefer it over PMXML. Same known-lossy fields as PMXML.
labels.tm_tt_diff_model: 4D Schedule Diff — grade an IMPORTED P6/MSP schedule per-phase against the model. It compares their durations to our own real-quantity + labor-rate estimate (import a file first)
labels.tm_locked_hint: Locked — click 🔒 Locked to enable editing
labels.tm_edit_exception: Time Machine couldn't complete this edit — {reason}
labels.tm_not_editable: Not editable — no schedule task on this bar
labels.tm_no_baseline_yet: No schedule to baseline yet — generate a 4D schedule first
labels.tm_nothing_to_compress: Nothing to compress — schedule is already at earliest float
labels.tm_cannot_edit_no_dates: Cannot edit — no real dates found for this task
labels.tm_refused_cycle: Refused — that link would create a cycle
labels.tm_linked_clamped: Linked, but {task} clamped to {start} — blocked by {by}
labels.tm_breach: ⚠ Integrity Breach: {list} — press ↺ Undo edit (or fix), then lock again
labels.tm_tt_cpm:
Critical Path Method, recomputed after every edit. Red = zero total float: the task cannot slip without moving the project end. Green = it has slack.
Project duration {pf}d · total float {minF}..{maxF}d.
CPM reads the dates the drag produced — it never changes one.
labels.tm_no_project_records: No project records for this model
labels.tm_interop_not_loaded: Interop module not loaded — reopen the P6/MSP section
labels.tm_prebound: Pre-bound {n} elements across {a} activities by convention
labels.tm_bind_hint: ({n} activities carry a bind token — tick auto-bind to resolve.)
labels.tm_exported_msp: Exported {n} tasks / {m} links to MS Project XML ({file}).
labels.tm_exported_p6: Exported {n} tasks / {m} links to {label} ({file}). Some fields (WBS code, EPS-level activity codes, resource assignments, global calendars, baselines) are not carried — P6 itself drops most of these on cross-DB import.
labels.tm_diff_needs_import: Diff vs Model compares an IMPORTED P6/MSP schedule against our real-quantity estimate — import one first.
labels.tm_diff_summary: 4D Schedule Diff: {a}/{b} phases compared, {c}/{d} activities matched.
labels.wi_sub: Drag a phase bar to slip it (or use ± for ±7d) → every downstream phase re-folds in blue (finish-to-start). Accept to re-baseline, Discard to drop.
labels.wi_no_project: What-if: no folded project yet — push one to ERP first

labels.mdl_dim_move_tt: Move/nudge step (m) — arrow keys move the selection by this (Shift ×10, Alt ÷10)

labels.mdl_dim_h_tt: Sketch height (m) — Enter re-solves the whole rect/square, drag-one-dimension style
labels.mdl_dim_angle_tt: Sketch corner angle (°, default 90) — Enter re-solves as a parallelogram at the typed angle
labels.mdl_dim_radius_tt: Circle radius (m) — Enter sets the radius exactly (commits a pending centre, or edits the latest circle)
